question: Where was the main Infantry Day wreath laying ceremony held on the occasion of 79th Valour Day in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National War Memorial**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The main wreath-laying ceremony for the **79th Infantry Day**, also celebrated as **Valour Day** (Shaurya Diwas) in **2025**, was organized at the **National War Memorial** in **New Delhi**.
 
• This day is celebrated every year on **October 27** to commemorate the first **military action** of independent India in **1947**.
 
• During the ceremony, the **Chief of Army Staff (COAS)**, along with senior military commanders and decorated veterans, pays homage to the **bravehearts** who laid down their lives for the nation.
 
• The **2025** celebration marks the **79th anniversary** of the landing of the **1st Battalion of the Sikh Regiment** at **Srinagar Airfield** to protect **Jammu and Kashmir** from invade
